sources.title: INVEST in Good Stories, and SMART Tasks

claims.statement: A good story is testable, so every criterion of a work item says how it is checked → Essentials, writing criteria
A story is valuable, independent and testable, so items are cut by outcome and not by layer, because a layer item cannot be verified alone → cut rules

sources.title: Xonovex work-item definition conventions
sources.provenance: Repository-original procedure for turning the draft work outline of a change into work items and an optional work package, on the shared work item schema, template and write rules of recording-handoff

claims.statement: The cut proposal before any write, the operator's team as the scope, waiting rows kept at their outline with a non-empty `waits_on`, one repository for each item, real blockers only in `depends_on` and an acyclic graph, the optional work package without criteria, attaching items to an existing package, work files edited in place and never renamed, and the separate confirmation that sets `stable` with a `human:` actor are conventions of this workflow.
